visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a large block of yellow hard cheese being grated over a pan of cooked linguine pasta and clams with basil leaves. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) A man in a black t-shirt is sitting at a wooden dining table, using a fork to pick up a large mouthful of the pasta and eating it with a satisfied expression. (3) A series of quick cuts shows the raw ingredients: sliced onions, minced garlic, fresh basil leaves, a bowl of closed clams, and a bundle of dry thin pasta, all laid out in metal bowls on a kitchen counter. (4) The cooking process starts with a square stainless steel pan on a gas stove. Oil is poured from a light-colored bottle, followed by the addition of onions and garlic which are stirred with a metal spatula. (5) Clams are added to the pan, water is poured from a metal cup, and the pan is covered with a lid to steam. The scene then shows the clams opening up as they cook. (6) The cooked clams are removed and set aside in a bowl. Thin pasta is placed in the remaining liquid in the square pan, more water is added, and oil is drizzled over the boiling pasta. (7) A woman with long reddish-brown hair is seen in profile tasting the pasta from the pan with a fork in the kitchen. (8) The clams are returned to the pan with the pasta, and a handful of fresh basil is added and mixed in. (9) More of the hard cheese is grated over the finished dish directly in the square pan. (10) The woman, wearing a grey t-shirt with a cat graphic and jeans, carries the pan into a dining room and sets it on the wooden table using a detachable handle. (11) The man continues to eat the pasta and a clam from the pan, looking directly at the camera while gesturing that the food is good.
